concepts.gloss_en: Expanded/mature mental faculties (gadlut ha-mochin); clarified intellect associated with mercies and kindnesses

reason_for_human: The only difference between the two forms is the prepositional prefix ל- ("to/toward"); the head phrase גדלות המחין is identical. Both denote the same technical concept of expanded consciousness, so this is inflectional/prefix variation, not a homograph. Straightforward merge.
